reason: I travel twice a month and magnesium after gym is something I already think about, so a sachet I can throw in my bag with the capsules already counted is easy. At $24.99 with the money-back guarantee I would try one box on impulse.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference, or is it just another box I stop taking after two weeks? Nothing here promises anything and I can't tell from a page.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing a real week of using it, especially on travel days, so I can see it hit a problem I actually have.
